notes: Ranges are the confirmed centimeter limits converted once: height 5-35 cm, camera 25-80 cm, distance 10-800 cm.
Region identity is the configured object and material, not a pixel color test at sample time.
Distance is log-uniform and yaw is stratified by bin, so draws are not uniform. Accepted samples are whatever survives rejection.
Footprint rays, radial clearance and the visibility grid are discrete checks, not a continuous collision or occlusion proof.
min_projected_span_px, look offset and visibility grid are initial screening values, not a calibrated camera policy.
